newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds jump after CPI, retail sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds jump after CPI, retail sales.

text.p: U.S. mortgaged-backed securities investors generally stayed on the sidelines on Friday after market-friendly reports on inflation and retail sales, traders said.
"Mortgages are very thin today," one trader said. "That's mostly from volatility, and I don't think there's a lot of retail interest."
By late Friday, pass-throughs were up 11/32 to a full point but had come off their earlier highs. The 10-year Treasury note was up 32/32, and the five-year note had climbed 21/32.
